monthly_income.description: Average verified monthly income or inflow over 24-month window

monthly_expenses.description: Average monthly living and non-debt operational expenses

monthly_emi.description: Average monthly debt service and installment commitments

cash_flow_surplus.description: Net uncommitted cash surplus (Income - Expenses - EMI)

debt_to_income.description: Ratio of monthly debt obligations to monthly income

average_balance.description: Average daily bank or digital wallet account balance

minimum_balance_ratio.description: Ratio of lowest observed balance to monthly income (liquidity stress floor)

income_stability.description: Normalized stability metric of monthly earnings over 24 months

expense_volatility.description: Volatility and variability of monthly expenditures

transaction_regularity.description: Consistency score of recurring digital transactions across observation periods

negative_cashflow_months.description: Number of observed months where living expenses and debt exceeded total inflows

income_trend_3m.description: Trailing income trajectory percentage comparing recent vs earliest observation periods

utility_payment_consistency.description: Proportion of recurring utility and telecom invoices settled on or before due date

digital_transaction_ratio.description: Proportion of transactions conducted via traceable digital payment rails (UPI, cards, netbanking)

savings_rate.description: Proportion of monthly income retained as uncommitted savings

failed_payment_count.description: Count of bounced checks, ECS rejections, NACH failures, or failed debits

non_debt_recurring_obligations.description: Essential non-debt recurring commitments such as utilities, rent, and telecom (excluding debt EMI)

existing_debt_amount.description: Estimated total outstanding principal debt obligations

credit_history_available.description: Whether any formal bureau record exists (0 for unbanked/thin-file)

credit_history_length.description: Duration of formal credit relationship in months (0 for unbanked)
